title: Children on Boat Deck Railing, 1930s Maritime B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage black-and-white snapshot capturing three young siblings on what appears to be the deck of a ferry or passenger ship. To the right, an older boy holds an infant or toddler bundled up in a winter bonnet and coat. To the left, a girl wearing a belted overcoat and hat leans casually against the boat's wire mesh railing. Sun flare and light overexposure are visible across the bottom and sky, typical of amateur folding or box camera snapshots of the 1930s era.
